🚀 tegaki | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create engaging, animated handwriting effects for text content on websites and in digital presentations.
✨ Key Features: • Animates any font into handwriting • No manual path authoring or native dependencies • React component for easy integration • Command-line interface for SVG generation • Supports multiple frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, SolidJS, Astro, Vanilla JS, Web Components)
📖 Summary: Tegaki is a TypeScript library that animates any font into handwriting, creating a stroke-by-stroke drawing effect for the web. It supports various frameworks and offers a command-line interface for generating animated SVGs.
